It also describes a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. The architectural claim is specific; it should not be simplified into a claim that attention has become free or that any million-token input is equally useful.","zh":"v1报告描述的结构是：每三层线性注意力配合一层softmax注意力，并使用扩展到负特征值的gated delta rule。这个架构描述很具体，不能被简化成“注意力成本消失了”，更不能说明任意100万token输入都同样有效。"},{"en":"My engineering reading is that context capacity and useful memory are separate properties. An agent may fit its entire history yet fail to retrieve an early requirement. I would test cross-file dependencies, constraints introduced early in a session, and distractor-heavy documents at several input lengths, while recording prefill time and peak memory.","zh":"从工程角度看，装得下与记得住是两回事。Agent可能容纳完整历史，却无法取回最早的一条需求。我会在不同输入长度下测试跨文件依赖、会话早期约束，以及混入大量干扰信息的文档，同时记录预填充耗时和峰值内存。"}],"sources":[1]},{"heading":{"en":"Specialists need to become one usable policy","zh":"训练思路：让领域专家最终成为一个可用策略"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"The report trains twelve domain specialists and combines them with Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. In on-policy distillation, the student's own generated trajectory determines where supervision is applied. This is different from simply collecting polished teacher answers and treating them as a static instruction dataset.","zh":"报告训练了12个领域专家，再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation）整合其能力。在线策略蒸馏关注学生按自身策略生成的轨迹，并在这些位置给予指导；这与只收集教师的漂亮答案、做成静态指令数据集存在区别。"},{"en":"For a deployment team, the next question is skill interference. Keep the verifier independent from the generated explanation. Evaluate missing evidence and conflicting instructions deliberately.
